summary: Iteration 25 — FRONTEND-ONLY test of the design-system refinement (Poppins global font + Nearby Professionals bottom sheet redesign). Backend not tested per request. TWO CRITICAL REGRESSIONS FOUND, both caused by the new global font patch in /app/frontend/src/lib/global-font.ts. (1) POPPINS IS NOT ACTUALLY APPLIED ON WEB: DOM inspection of every text element on /login, /, /nearby, /profile shows computed fontFamily = '-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif' (never any 'Poppins-*'). The four @font-face declarations for Poppins-Regular/Medium/SemiBold/Bold ARE registered by expo-font, but the Text.render monkey-patch never lands the fontFamily onto the rendered DOM node on react-native-web — RN-Web resolves Text.props.style into an internal className BEFORE render returns, so the fontFamily inline-style added by cloneElement is dropped/overridden. Result: users see system font, not Poppins, on every screen. (2) WHITE-SCREEN CRASH on multiple routes with a repeating console error: TypeError: Failed to set an indexed property [0] on 'CSSStyleDeclaration': Indexed property setter is not supported. Origin: expo-router/entry.bundle → setValueForStyle → the cloneElement in applyGlobalFont passes { style: [el.props.style, { fontFamily }] } (an ARRAY) as a DOM prop. On react-native-web the Text element has already been rendered to a DOM node, so React DOM tries to assign the array to element.style, which throws. Followed immediately by 'An error occurred in the <span> component' error boundary. Reproduced deterministically on /pings, /requests, /sessions, /forgot-password parent flows and on direct navigation to /. Some screens (nearby, encounters, profile, login, radar via redirect chain) survive because their first-render Text elements don't hit the failing branch, but the same error still fires 1–2 times per navigation. Positive results: the Nearby Professionals sheet redesign itself works (once you can reach it): sheet header expands, title + live counter '13 professionals nearby · 4 available now · 13 verified · 1 pending', quick filter chips render (Online/Available Now/Verified/Top Rated + category chips HR/Legal/Accounting/Finance/Marketing/Technology/Business Consulting/Engineering/…), horizontal carousel of ProCarouselCard renders (avatar+status dot, name+shield-checkmark, profession+category icon, Top Rated pill, rating+reviews, distance, availability, Connect button). Counter reacts to filters live: qf-online 13→9, qf-top-rated 13→7, qf-cat-HR 13→1, qf-verified 13→13 (all seeded pros are verified — expected). Tap on card opens ProfessionalPreviewSheet (Tom / Top Rated / Orrbbit Verified / 4.6 (5) / About 90m / Usually replies within a day / 6 yrs experience / 5 completed sessions / category tags / bio / View Full Profile + Connect). pro-card-connect-{id} navigates to /professional/connect/{id} with the correct request form (category chip grid, message textarea with 0/300, Send Request, response-time hint, 'messaging becomes available only after they accept' notice). Forgot-password link on /login navigates to /forgot-password with Email + Send Reset Code (email step) — clean. Explore Demo login on /login works (POST /api/auth/demo-login, lands on / as demo@intro.demo). Ping modals still auto-appear and dismiss correctly. React Native red screen: none. shadow*/pointerEvents/useNativeDriver deprecation warnings are pre-existing (already reported in iterations 21/23/24) and not introduced by this change.

The @font-face declarations register but the Text.render patch's cloneElement fontFamily override does not reach the DOM (RN-Web serialised style to className before render() returned). User will NOT see Poppins on web preview / production web deploys, only the system font.

integration_issues.issue: Both /requests and /sessions render an empty white document (body.innerText length = 0) due to the CSSStyleDeclaration error thrown from the global font patch. Session chat + message send flow could not be tested at all — the screen is blank.

react_native_issues.issue: Monkey-patching Text.render and returning React.cloneElement(el, { style: [el.props.style, { fontFamily }] }) is unsafe on react-native-web. After RN-Web's own Text render completes, el is already a DOM element and el.props.style is a plain object (or className-backed), so wrapping it in an array causes React DOM to call setValueForStyle with an indexed CSSStyleDeclaration assignment which throws. Recommended fix: (a) drop the Text.render monkey-patch entirely and instead set a default fontFamily on the app-wide Text via defaultProps or a wrapper AppText component; OR (b) inside the patch, if the platform is web, MERGE styles into a single object instead of returning an array — e.g. React.cloneElement(el, { style: { ...(StyleSheet.flatten(el.props.style)||{}), fontFamily } }). Also gate the patch with a Platform.OS check so native builds keep the array form if that is what is needed there.
Pre-existing (also flagged in iterations 21/23/24). Not introduced here. Migrate to boxShadow when convenient.

action_items: CRITICAL: Rework applyGlobalFont in /app/frontend/src/lib/global-font.ts — on react-native-web the ARRAY style prop returned by cloneElement crashes React DOM. Either (a) merge the style into a single object instead of using an array, or (b) skip the monkey-patch on web and rely on Text default styling / an AppText wrapper. Guarding with Platform.OS !== 'web' short-circuit is the smallest safe change.

HIGH: Even after the crash is fixed, verify Poppins actually reaches the DOM (computed fontFamily should include 'Poppins-*'). Currently the patch is a no-op on web — the user still sees system fonts. A wrapper <AppText> that sets fontFamily via StyleSheet is more reliable across web/native.

Re-run this exact test (Explore Demo → People radar → Professional radar → I Need Help sheet expand → quick filters → card tap → Connect → Requests/Sessions tabs → forgot-password) after the fix. All routes must render (body.innerText > 0) with zero console errors, and Text elements must show Poppins in computed styles.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/src/lib/global-font.ts:28 — Passing an array to `style` when cloneElement wraps an already-rendered RN-Web Text is the root cause. React DOM's setValueForStyle expects an object; it tries to set numeric indices on element.style and throws. This wipes the mounted subtree, which is why /pings, /requests, /sessions, and (sometimes) / go blank.

/app/frontend/app/_layout.tsx:19 — applyGlobalFont() is invoked at module load before font files finish loading (fontsLoaded gates render, but the patch is already installed globally). Consider moving inside useEffect after fontsLoaded === true, and only applying on native.

/app/frontend/src/components/ProfessionalHome.tsx — Sheet redesign itself is well-structured (Nearby Professionals title + counter, QuickChip row, FlatList carousel, ProCarouselCard). testIDs are consistent (qf-online/qf-available/qf-verified/qf-top-rated/qf-cat-*, pro-carousel, nearby-count, pro-card-*, pro-card-connect-*). File is 728 lines — approaching the 700-line advisory limit; extracting the CanHelp branch and QuickChip/MapSheet helpers to their own files would keep it lean.

rca_of_issue: Root cause: /app/frontend/src/lib/global-font.ts monkey-patches Text.render and returns React.cloneElement(el, { style: [el.props.style, { fontFamily }] }). On react-native-web, Text.render has already resolved the RN style into a DOM-ready form (className plus optional inline-style object) before we get `el`. Wrapping that in a JS array and re-passing it as the `style` prop to a DOM node causes React DOM's setValueForStyle to call element.style[0] = ... which throws 'Failed to set an indexed property [0] on CSSStyleDeclaration'. That exception unmounts the subtree, producing the white-screen crash observed on /pings, /requests, /sessions, /, and welcome. Secondary consequence: even on screens that render, the fontFamily inline style is never applied (RN-Web's className wins over the inline array), so Poppins is never actually visible. Reproduction: page.goto('/pings') after Explore Demo → console shows the TypeError 2x and body.innerText length is 0. Mitigation options: (1) guard `applyGlobalFont` with `if (Platform.OS !== 'web') return;` — safest, restores native intent while unblocking web; (2) inside the patch, merge into a single object: `style: { ...(StyleSheet.flatten(el.props.style)||{}), fontFamily }`; (3) replace the monkey-patch with a top-level <AppText> wrapper that adds fontFamily via StyleSheet.create — most portable and lets computed styles verify Poppins on web.
